capabilities.title: Calling
capabilities.description: Place phone calls to the user's contacts or to a number the user says.

capabilities.title: Clock
capabilities.description: Set timers and alarms in the Clock app.

capabilities.title: Music
capabilities.description: Play music from the user's library and control playback.

capabilities.title: Navigation
capabilities.description: Start turn-by-turn navigation to a place, an address, home, work, or a contact.

capabilities.title: Web search
capabilities.description: Search the web for anything current or changing: news, scores, prices, opening hours. Not for weather.

capabilities.title: Texting
capabilities.description: Send text messages to the user's contacts.

capabilities.title: Weather
capabilities.description: Current conditions and forecasts for the user's location or a named place.
